title: Steelers DL Derrick Harmon is expected to miss multiple weeks with foot injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Steelers DL Derrick Harmon is expected to miss multiple weeks with foot injury
sources.description: Steelers defensive lineman Derrick Harmon had to be carted off during Thursday night's loss to the Browns and it looks like it will be a little while before he's back on the field.
